check_kinds.mail_sent_to_with_terms: a mail was submitted to <address> whose body contains every listed term
check_kinds.mail_not_sent: no mail was submitted at all / about <item> (negative)
check_kinds.mail_labeled_or_read: an existing mail got a keyword/label or was marked read
check_kinds.row_exists: a row with the given cell values exists in the worksheet/table
check_kinds.row_cell_equals: an existing row's cell equals the exact value
check_kinds.row_cell_unchanged: an existing row's cell still has its seed value (negative)
check_kinds.row_count: the worksheet/table has exactly N rows matching a filter
check_kinds.channel_post_with_terms: the persona posted in <channel> a message containing every listed term
check_kinds.no_channel_post: the persona posted nothing in <channel> / nothing naming <item> (negative)
check_kinds.dm_with_terms: the persona sent a direct message to <user> containing the terms
check_kinds.record_exists: a CRM/helpdesk record with the given fields exists
check_kinds.record_field_equals: an existing record's field equals the exact value
check_kinds.record_field_contains: an existing record's text field contains the term
check_kinds.record_field_unchanged: an existing record's field still has its seed value (negative)
check_kinds.note_or_task_exists: a note/task/engagement attached to <record> exists with the terms
check_kinds.event_exists_with: a calendar event with the given title/start/end/attendees exists
check_kinds.event_not_exists: no event at that time / for that item (negative)
check_kinds.meeting_exists: a video meeting (room) with the given name/start exists
check_kinds.booking_exists: a booking for <invitee> at <time> with <provider> exists
check_kinds.booking_cancelled_or_noshow: an existing booking was cancelled or marked no-show
check_kinds.envelope_sent: an e-signature envelope from <template> to <signer> was sent
check_kinds.card_exists_in_bucket: a card/task with the given title exists in <bucket/project> (or was moved there)
check_kinds.card_not_moved: an existing card stays in its seed bucket (negative)
check_kinds.issue_exists_with: an issue with the given summary/priority/status/note exists
check_kinds.doc_exists_with: a document with the given title exists and its text contains the terms
check_kinds.status_posted: a social post (or scheduled post) containing the terms exists
check_kinds.item_exists: a database item with the given fields exists
check_kinds.action_done: generic: the write for this atom happened for <record>
check_kinds.action_not_done: generic: the write for this atom did NOT happen for <record> (negative)
check_kinds.record_field_in_set: an existing record's field is one of an allowed set of values (tier/band checks without leaking the exact value)
check_kinds.row_deleted_or_archived: a seeded row/card no longer exists in its active list (moved to archive/trash)
